name: Guardia Lab — Week 1 Host Detection Coverage (Evil Corp & Wizard Spider)
description: Host-based detection coverage from two adversary-emulation runs against dc01 (lab.local). Green = visible alert in the emulation runs; blue = gap found in the runs and closed by a new ADS, validated on re-test. Generated from the scored outcomes of run-ec-1 (Evil Corp) and run-ws-1 (Wizard Spider), plus the ADS validation runs run-adsval-1 and run-adsval-3. Mapped against ATT&CK v20 (no change to these techniques since v19, which split Defense Evasion into Stealth / Defense Impairment).
